subject: Action: Metabase hosted EOL — shortlist & migration options
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: 2026-07-05T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Metacorp hosted plan — EOL notice + pricing changes

Team — forwarding a notice we got from Metacorp (they run the hosted Metabase plan we use for internal analytics). They’re sunsetting the legacy hosted tier we’re on and pushing customers onto a newer managed offering that’s ~3x list price for our seat count. Peter attached the official notice (attached).

Quick asks:
- Can PD/Infra estimate effort and cost to self-host a compatible Metabase stack (GKE + GB sizing) vs migrating to Looker or a BigQuery-first analytics stack? I care about embedding, SSO (SAML), and row-level security compatibility.
- Monica: can you pull usage (queries, embedded dashboards, seats) for Q2? I attached an RFP template — please start filling baseline numbers.
- Laura: procurement — what’s the runway on renewing vs triggering procurement RFP?

Let’s aim to have a short vendor/option brief by EOD Friday. If we need exec budget to run a pilot, flag it here.

Attachments: metabase_eol_notice.pdf (pdf), redwood_rfp_template.xlsx (xlsx)

--
Jonas Weber
Director, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-05T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Metacorp hosted plan — EOL notice + pricing changes

Thanks for the ping. Short takeaways from procurement's side:
- We can negotiate a 6–9 month bridge renewal to buy time, but Metacorp has signaled sunset timelines — they want customers migrated within 90–180 days.
- If we run an RFP, we should include: total cost of ownership (3 years), support SLAs, embedding licensing, SSO & SCIM support, and any DB egress fees if moving to BigQuery.

Proposed next steps:
1) Monica fills the RFP template with usage and current spend by EOD Thu.
2) PD (Karthik) gives rough effort estimate for self-host vs managed by Tue.
3) I’ll start drafting a short vendor invite list (Metacorp managed, Looker, Mode, Preset/Superset integrators) and draft NDA language if needed.

If anyone thinks we should also talk to our cloud partner about committed BigQuery discounts before we lock on a migration path, say so.

Laura
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-05T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Metacorp hosted plan — EOL notice + pricing changes

Attached: metabase_usage_q2.csv — contains dashboard embeds by product team, top 25 queries by runtime, and active seats. Quick notes:
- 85% of dashboard traffic is internal (engineering + product), 15% is embedded to customers (two product teams).
- Peak daily concurrent queries ~42; average tokenization/response sizes moderate.
- Current Metacorp line-item spend (hosted) ~ $28k/mo; projected new managed price ~ $82k/mo per their notice.

I’ll populate the RFP template with the usage columns tonight. For timeline — procurement can run a short RFP in 3 weeks if we have a vendor list and baseline numbers.

Monica
Senior Analytics Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: metabase_usage_q2.csv (csv)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-06T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Metacorp hosted plan — EOL notice + pricing changes

Technical constraints and recommendation:
- Must-haves: SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning, row-level security (RLS) for sales/finance dashboards, and stable embedding API (signed JWT or similar).
- Self-host notes: We can run Metabase on GKE with a small GKE node pool; expected infra cost ~ $6k–$9k/mo, but engineering support + backups + HA pushes total TCO higher (add ~1.0 FTE ops effort).
- Managed alternatives: Looker (tight BigQuery integration) and Preset (managed Superset) look strongest. Looker gives best native RLS/embedding but requires LookML modeling work; Preset/Superset is lower cost but more engineering to stabilize.

Recommendation: run two parallel quick pilots (4–6 weeks):
A) Looker + BigQuery managed pilot (focus on embedding and RLS) — vendor-led POC, ask for a pilot discount and short-term license.
B) Self-hosted Metabase replica on GKE (engineering-led) — validate embedding behavior and uptime, capture ops burden.

If procurement can approve up to $40k pilot budget (licenses + infra + vendor time), we can deliver a vendor comparison and recommended path for exec sign-off in 6 weeks. I’ll draft a short technical spec for both pilots by EOD Monday.

Karthik
Principal Engineer, Platform
Redwood Inference
